activities.label: Well Rested
activities.text: You and allies completing a long rest together.

rules.text: A contested check against a Charisma or Wisdom skill: advantage; then not for 10 minutes. (Its copy of Well Rested's Amp is removed, as King Q-E12.)

After each rest, a Dream Walker (Fey, Beast, Dragon, Spider or Demon) obeys only you and acts on your turn: Move (free), Strike (forgo attacks for its Strike), Distort (Bonus action: its ability, your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu save DC); 7th: Pass Through (your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu can come from it) and Inflict Harm (its Strikes for your Taijutsu or Bukijutsu). At 0 it's gone until a rest. 2 Oni-Coils: use a chakra construct's stat block from a jutsu or feature instead. Its stat block (in this item; save bonuses blank) is held for King's (H8).

activities.label: Memory Haze
activities.text: Your manifest weapon's [Weapon Damage] (psychic). Failure: Confused.

activities.label: Stolen Thoughts
activities.text: Your manifest weapon's [Weapon Damage]. Failure: you learn its most immediate goals and it forgets them for 1 minute.

rules.text: After a rest, proficiency with one weapon group; those weapons turn ethereal for you only and deal psychic. If the creature already saves against the damage, apply these on its failure.

activities.label: Inner Self
activities.text: Bonus action, a Dream Walker active, once per long rest (or 2 Oni-Coils to do it early): fuse into it for 1 minute (its scores, attacks, abilities and hit points; your proficiencies and jutsu plus its own). At 0 you revert and it's dispelled.

rules.text: One Lucid Dream for your Dream Walker (change it on any rest): the option items.

Elemental: one nature release you have (or 1d6: Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Lightning, reroll); two C-Rank or lower jutsu of it you know (or the listed pair) become abilities, twice per initiative each. (On the Dream Walker, held: H8.)

Vegetative: Flowers (poison), Fungi (necrotic) or Moss (acid) (pick with Medical Release, or 1d4); two matching C-Rank or lower jutsu (or the listed pair), twice per initiative each. (On the Dream Walker, held: H8.)
Warrior: two C-Rank or lower Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you know (or Brute, Samurai or Ninja's pair), twice per initiative each. (On the Dream Walker, held: H8.)
A rank of Mastery on Intelligence and Wisdom saves.

Oni-Coils: 1 + proficiency bonus (the pool), back on a rest. Two Onijutsu (+1 at 7th and 15th): the option items; each appears in the cast dialog of your Genjutsu (once per turn, up to 2 per casting).

castOptions.label: Onijutsu: Infectious Genjutsu (1 Oni-Coil)
castOptions.note: a failed save or hit makes it a relay until the start of your next turn: once per turn an ally of it moving within 10 feet saves against the Genjutsu as the original target.

rules.text: Infectious Genjutsu: a failed save or hit makes it a relay until the start of your next turn: once per turn an ally of it moving within 10 feet saves against the Genjutsu as the original target.

castOptions.label: Onijutsu: Overwhelming Illusions (1 Oni-Coil)
castOptions.note: a creature that succeeds raises its jutsu costs by the rank (D +4 ... S +20) until the end of its next turn.

rules.text: Overwhelming Illusions: a creature that succeeds raises its jutsu costs by the rank (D +4 ... S +20) until the end of its next turn.

castOptions.label: Onijutsu: Punishing Illusions (1 Oni-Coil)
castOptions.note: a creature that succeeds resaves; failing, it suffers the Success effects and is Confused.

rules.text: Punishing Illusions: a creature that succeeds resaves; failing, it suffers the Success effects and is Confused.

castOptions.label: Onijutsu: Sensory Domination (1 Oni-Coil)
castOptions.note: a failing creature with a special sense is Blinded for the duration (or until the start of your next turn).

rules.text: Sensory Domination: a failing creature with a special sense is Blinded for the duration (or until the start of your next turn).

castOptions.label: Onijutsu: Subtle Illusion (1 Oni-Coil)
castOptions.note: no HS or CS; you need eye or physical contact with the target.

rules.text: Subtle Illusion: no HS or CS; you need eye or physical contact with the target.

castOptions.label: Onijutsu: The Pain Is Real (2 Oni-Coils)
castOptions.note: It becomes a Genjutsu with Tactile (it loses its Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu keywords).

rules.text: The Pain Is Real: a damaging Action Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu becomes a Genjutsu (loses those keywords, gains Genjutsu and Tactile).

castOptions.label: Onijutsu: Versatile Authority (1 Oni-Coil)
castOptions.note: a creature with a Physical or Elemental condition gets no jutsu bonuses to its save.

rules.text: Versatile Authority: a creature with a Physical or Elemental condition gets no jutsu bonuses to its save.

castOptions.label: Onijutsu: Will Breaker (1 Oni-Coil)
castOptions.note: a failing creature takes −1 on its next Strength or Dexterity save (−2 at 11th).

rules.text: Will Breaker: a failing creature takes −1 on its next Strength or Dexterity save (−2 at 11th).
